description: validation.rs defines a sync MsgIdStorage trait used by check_duplicate(). ingestion.rs uses MsgIdMap directly (async). These are two separate deduplication mechanisms that are not connected. Any call path that reaches validate_article_ingress + check_duplicate without also calling check_ingest bypasses the async MsgIdMap dedup entirely — and vice versa. If a new ingress path (e.g. POST handler) calls only validate_article_ingress it gets the sync trait, which requires a separate in-memory store that may not be backed by the real DB. Audit whether every ingress path calls check_ingest (async, real storage) and whether check_duplicate + MsgIdStorage are actually reachable from production code. If MsgIdStorage is only used in tests, mark it cfg(test) or remove it; if it is used in production, it must be wired to the real MsgIdMap.
notes: Pre-existing structural issue; MsgIdStorage sync trait predates UUCP work. Deferring.
title: Two independent dedup paths (sync MsgIdStorage vs async MsgIdMap) can drift
